analysis:
Both units are BASE-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (base lines 1064-1573). The PR modifies only documentation: the patch replaces the v0.10.7 candidate header at the top of the file with a v0.10.8 candidate and adds about 320 lines of release notes. No source, protocol, key-handling, attestation, authorization or cache code changes, so no runtime control is altered by this diff.

The base excerpts are historical release notes (v0.10.5 to v0.10.2 and parts of the unreleased sections). They mention T-041-related SSD prefix-cache behavior, the add-on hold (TB-012/T-059/T-060), the Sandbox CLI installer (TB-013/T-061), and App Attest traffic and re-registration. These describe pre-existing behavior and are not changed by this PR. Some notes record behavior the threat model may want to track: the cache TTL and daily-write-budget semantics, restore mtime refresh and TTL maintenance, and delta checkpoints. They do not loosen the 30-minute TTL or the HMAC-keyed names, and they match the T-041 posture.

One security-relevant statement is visible only in the truncated patch excerpt: both Macs of a pair must run the same build and otherwise refuse to pair, which fails closed. Cluster pairing, sealed tensor-parallel exchanges and the coordinator's pair-approval limit are outside the supplied evidence. The rest of the head-side notes were not supplied, so claims there about encrypted per-piece exchange or pair-update behavior are unverified.

No finding is made because the supplied evidence shows only documentation changes. The next pass should check the actual code behind the new v0.10.8 notes, the pairing-refusal and update flow, and the sealed 256 KiB tensor-parallel pieces, none of which is in this batch.
